text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking along the
riverbank...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Okay, after this break, I'll do
another run!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello. You're one of the trainers
from the
academy, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the compliment! However,
I'm still
not where I want to be.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There's someone I look up to, and I'll
have to
work much harder if I ever hope
to catch up to
her!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen is—I mean, Maruzensky is my
idol!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She's so fast and elegant and cool! Not
only that,
she's great at driving and
delightfully kind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She's the flashiest gentlewoman ever!
She's my
everything!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What I mean to say is... Maruzen is just
sooo
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I hope I can be as incredible as her one day...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sigh. You're right...
choice_data_list: I think staying true to yourself i...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard I try, I'll never be
Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In every age are faint hopes doomed to
be
trapped in the fickle and violent line
between
dream and reality...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But at the very least, my dream of
standing on the same stage as her one
day is still within my
grasp. At least, I
believe it is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll stay true to myself and continue
working hard without overdoing it. By
doing so, I'm sure I, too,
will bloom
someday.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thank you! I feel a lot more
confident now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Okay, break time's over! It's time to get
running
again!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I feel much more sure of
myself
hearing that from you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But it will be a long and perilous road to
get to
where Maruzen is. She's
accomplished some truly
amazing things.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still,
I believe I'll be able to stand on the
same
stage as her one day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I may be but a small bud now, but if I
work hard
each and every day...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My dream will come into a full and
beautiful
bloom, just as the cherry
blossoms do every
spring!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Okay, break time's over! It's time to get
running
again!
